units.rawText: At first, when I learned you were human, I had some doubts. Especially when I saw how you command Dolls in battle... I was very worried that you might be just like the humans who designed us.

units.rawText: But after fighting side by side with you, I understood why Simo made the choice he did... You've never treated us as weapons, but as comrades, partners, even family.

units.rawText: You have such a strong military air, yet you often act unlike a soldier... I really like that about you. Fighting alongside a human like you is my greatest honor.

units.rawText: If someday... I also get the chance to go to the real world, I'd like to keep moving forward with you, under your command.

units.rawText: Hm? Why is your face red, Professor? Did I say something... Ah... N-no, I meant as partners... ah... Calm down, Olivia, calm down... Phew...
